## Goal

As a maintainer, I want the ruff `I001` import-sorting warning introduced into `dev` by PR #716 removed, so the repository is lint-clean.

## Problem

Merging PR #716 (SA-0MUDXPXWZ003F18C) added `import run_tests` followed by a blank line and `from run_tests import (...)` in `skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py` (around line 34). Ruff's isort rule `I001` flags the block as un-sorted/un-formatted. This was surfaced (medium, non-blocking) by the audit of SA-0MSISKM8F004NW1U during the v0.1.17 release attempt.

- `ruff check --select I skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py` → `All checks passed!`.

- 8fa3ee61e8 is an ancestor of current `dev` HEAD (c85593478f).

**Duplicate check:** `wl search "I001 unsorted import test_run_tests_scope"` returns only this item — no overlapping work item.

**Conclusion:** No implementation work remains. AC1 holds on `dev`; AC3 holds because no edit is needed; AC2 is unaffected by this intake (lint-only, no tree change). Closing as already-fixed rather than drafting a brief for work that no longer exists.
